rows.document:
Community weaving workshop
【虛構標註素材，不是正式公告】
期限：Submit the enrollment form by 15:30 on 20 May 2028. Late forms will not be accepted.
應備文件：
Bring the confirmation email, the materials selection sheet, and a photo ID for inspection. A photocopy of the ID is not required.
費用：
The workshop fee is NT$240 per person. Students with a valid student card pay NT$90. Materials cost is charged separately, up to NT$80 per person.
其他事項：Participants whose registration is cancelled by the organizer receive a full workshop-fee refund; materials charges are refunded only for unopened kits.

fields.deadline: Submit the enrollment form by 15:30 on 20 May 2028. Late forms will not be accepted.
fields.required_documents: Bring the confirmation email, the materials selection sheet, and a photo ID for inspection. A photocopy of the ID is not required.
fields.amount: The workshop fee is NT$240 per person. Students with a valid student card pay NT$90. Materials cost is charged separately, up to NT$80 per person.
fields.conditions: Participants whose registration is cancelled by the organizer receive a full workshop-fee refund; materials charges are refunded only for unopened kits.

questions.question: 主辦單位取消報名時，工作坊費和已拆封材料費都會全額退嗎？
questions.answer: 工作坊費會全額退還，但材料費只有未拆封材料包才退，已拆封不符合這項條件。
evidence: Participants whose registration is cancelled by the organizer receive a full workshop-fee refund; materials charges are refunded only for unopened kits.

questions.question: 只帶證件影本就能完成現場查驗嗎？
questions.answer: 不可以，須帶確認電子郵件、材料選擇單與附照片證件供查驗；不需證件影本。
evidence: Bring the confirmation email, the materials selection sheet, and a photo ID for inspection. A photocopy of the ID is not required.

questions.question: 持有效學生證的90元費用已包含材料嗎？
questions.answer: 沒有，工作坊費為90元，材料另計，每人材料費上限80元。
evidence: The workshop fee is NT$240 per person. Students with a valid student card pay NT$90. Materials cost is charged separately, up to NT$80 per person.
